preferences.title: Preferences
preferences.description: Language for this device, and the currency your totals are shown in.
preferences.languageHelp: Saved in this browser only; the database is not affected.
preferences.defaultCurrencyHelp: Every account keeps its own currency. Dashboard totals, budgets and the transaction report convert into this one using the exchange rates below.
preferences.changeFailed: Failed to change the default currency

changeDialog.title: Change default currency?
changeDialog.body: Totals will be shown in {{to}} ({{toName}}) instead of {{from}}.
changeDialog.rebase: The exchange rates you entered will be re-expressed in {{to}} automatically.
changeDialog.forget: No rate is known for {{to}} yet, so the existing exchange rates will be cleared and must be entered again in {{to}}.
changeDialog.plansNote: Budget amounts, income sources and project or trip costs are not converted: they are treated as amounts in the new default currency.

preferences.ratesDescription: How much one unit of each currency is worth in {{defaultCurrency}}. Accounts in a currency without a rate are left out of the totals.
preferences.ratesEmpty: All accounts use {{defaultCurrency}}. Add a currency to enter a rate ahead of time.
preferences.rateSaveFailed: Failed to save the exchange rate

storage.title: Storage Management
storage.description: Monitor your browser storage usage and manage your data storage.
storage.infoAlert: Your budget data is stored locally in your browser using OPFS (Origin Private File System). This data persists between sessions and is tied to this specific browser and origin.
storage.localStorage: • Local Storage: Data is stored on your device and never sent to external servers
storage.browserLimits: • Browser Limits: Most browsers allow up to 60% of available disk space
storage.backupRecommended: • Backup Recommended: Export your data regularly to prevent loss

source.title: Database Source
source.description: Choose whether the working copy is local, Google Drive, or OneDrive. Cloud sources sync automatically about 15 seconds after changes settle, or on demand.
source.conflictAlert: The cloud copy changed while this device also had unsynced changes.
source.enterPassword: Enter your database password to resume cloud sync.
source.autoSyncHelp: When enabled, edits upload automatically shortly after you stop editing. Turn this off to only sync when you click "Sync Now".
source.syncFrequencyHelp: How long to wait after a local change before syncing automatically.

security.title: Security
security.description: Manage the password that protects your exports and cloud backups.
security.lockHelp: Syncs your database to the cloud (if connected), then locks it — you'll need your password to continue.
security.lockDialogBody: Your database couldn't be fully synced. Locking now leaves those changes unsynced until you unlock and reconnect. Lock anyway?
security.lockDialogBodyWithError: Your database couldn't be fully synced ({{error}}). Locking now leaves those changes unsynced until you unlock and reconnect. Lock anyway?

backup.title: Data & Backup
backup.description: Export your data for backup or import into other applications.
backup.exportHelp: Downloads a complete backup archive containing the VFS snapshot and dbstatus.json
backup.merchantRulesHelp: Merchant rules match bank charge descriptions to merchants and subscriptions on the Subscriptions page.
backup.ruleCounts: Currently {{community}} community rules and {{user}} of your own.
backup.reapplyHelp: Restores the bundled community rule list. Rules you have edited or disabled are left untouched.
backup.customRulesHelp: Download the rules you've created (not the community list) as a JSON file, in priority order, to back them up or move them to another browser. Importing the same file again updates matching rules instead of duplicating them.

display.title: Display Settings
display.description: Customize the appearance of your budget tracker.
display.presetsHelp: Choose how the app looks. Your selection is saved locally in this browser.

light.label: Light
light.description: Default spacious theme for everyday use.

dark.label: Dark
dark.description: Low-glare theme with dark surfaces and matching accents.

compact.label: Compact
compact.description: Denser light theme that fits more information on screen.

system.label: System
system.description: Follows your device light or dark appearance preference.

display.densityHelp: Automatic uses the compact layout on desktop widths and the comfortable layout on phones. Currently {{density}}.

changePassword.title: Change Password
changePassword.description: This password encrypts your database on this device, as well as exports and cloud backups. There is no password recovery, so store it somewhere safe.
changePassword.tooShort: New password must be at least {{count}} characters.
changePassword.syncWarning: Password changed locally, but the cloud backup could not be re-encrypted yet ({{error}}). It will retry automatically.

conflictDialog.title: Sync Conflict
conflictDialog.body: Both this device and the cloud copy have changed since they were last synced. Choose how to resolve it — nothing is uploaded or discarded until you pick an option below.
conflictDialog.discardWarning: This discards the unsynced changes on this device and replaces them with the cloud copy. This can't be undone.
